_help: Goombario (PM64) on c_kurio, by the owner's rule: the model's paper body (head, cap, stem, feet) moves as the sprite's, a key per sprite frame held as long (its head where the sprite's head is); his brows, eyes and mouth are the sprite's own pixels of that frame (sprite_parts, read from the player's ROM), the model's face parts hidden. One sprite pixel = 0.443 model unit. Our numbers only. Notes: local-docs/poses/goombario.md.
